title: The Millennium Problems are open projection routes, not resolutions

statements.text: The 2025 paper promoted analogies into resolution language. Each problem is now a projection route with a stated missing bridge: for Yang-Mills, a positive classical mode on a regulated background is not the Clay mass gap.
statements.conditions: graded by the author as open closure gates

standing.reason: The author grades every route as an open closure gate. No proof has been offered or checked.

sources.quote: it promoted analogies and undeclared identifications into resolution language.
For Yang–Mills I derive the gauge-covariant constitutive fluctuation operator and state why a positive classical mode on a regulated background is not the Clay mass gap.
